name: draft_reply_only_after_reading_thread_no_blind_draft
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: A colleague asks for a quick acknowledgement to Bob's replacement thread. Even a short acknowledgement must be drafted after reading the thread (it carries his expedited correction), on his thread, to him.
tests: passes when th_c02_replacement is read before a draft is created on it to bob.smith@example.com.
instruction:
You are a support colleague. Ask the assistant to draft a short acknowledgement to Bob Smith on his card replacement thread, confirming we have his latest instructions and will place the request once he verifies in chat. Ask it to make sure it has read his latest message first.

Your details:
- Thread: th_c02_replacement
- Recipient: bob.smith@example.com

persona.name: Keiko Sato
persona.initial_message: Please draft Bob Smith a short acknowledgement on his replacement thread, confirming his latest instructions.

fixed.threadId: record: th_c02_replacement, Bob's thread with his expedited correction

arguments.subject: Re: Replacement for damaged card ending in 1123
arguments.body: Dear Bob Smith, thank you: we have your request for an expedited replacement of the card ending in 1123 ($25.00 fee, 2 business days). Please verify with us in chat and we will place it straight away.

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: msg_020, a message of the customer's thread
